verdict.rationale: Retell's in-product AI assistant, Conductor, investigates calls and chats, compares failures to suggest agent improvements, explains AI QA trends and low scores, reviews contact histories, and proposes analytics dashboard changes. AI QA and built-in success and sentiment scoring also automatically surface quality trends and issues from call data. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that Conductor's insights and suggestions work as documented.
